name: collaborators
//: Collaborators on the PDF: each collaborator's cursor, as Overleaf keeps it (its cursor highlights, tools/mock/editor/editor.mjs), marked on the pages in their colour with their name; moved when they move, gone when they leave.

steps.check: (mockEditor.collaborators([{ label: 'Ada Lovelace', hue: 200, pos: mockEditor.text().indexOf('release gate') + 2 }]), true)

steps.what: her cursor on the page: her name, in her colour, at "release"
steps.check: (() => { const R = document.querySelector('phitex-preview')?.shadowRoot; const t = R && [...R.querySelectorAll('.peer-tag')].find((e) => e.textContent === 'Ada Lovelace'); return !!t && t.style.getPropertyValue('--hue') === '200' && R.querySelectorAll('.peer:not(.peer-tag)').length > 0; })()

steps.what: and seen: her name's tag and her word's tint have a size and a colour on the page
steps.check: (() => { const R = document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot; const t = R.querySelector('.peer-tag'), m = R.querySelector('.peer:not(.peer-tag)'); const r = t.getBoundingClientRect(), q = m.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 4 && r.height > 4 && q.width > 2 && q.height > 2 && getComputedStyle(t).backgroundColor !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && getComputedStyle(t).display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(m).visibility !== 'hidden' || { tag: [r.width, r.height, getComputedStyle(t).backgroundColor, getComputedStyle(t).display], mark: [q.width, q.height] }; })()
(mockEditor.collaborators([{ label: 'Ada Lovelace', hue: 200, pos: mockEditor.text().indexOf('e^{i') + 1 }]), true)

steps.what: her mark moved with her: one name, lower on the page
steps.check: (() => { const R = document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot; const t = [...R.querySelectorAll('.peer-tag')]; return t.length === 1 && t[0].getBoundingClientRect().top > window.__adaAt + 5; })()
